name: Stylized Water Lite for Godot 4 (TinyLanternDev)
summary: Free Lite edition of a stylized 3D water shader for Godot 4.7+: two Gerstner waves, colour by depth, shore foam line, the Tropical preset and a small example scene (Kenney CC0 rocks). GDScript and Godot shaders only, works on Forward+, Mobile and Compatibility/Web. The paid full pack ($14.99) adds 6 presets, caustics, SSR, floating objects, splashes, waterfall and underwater view.

access.license: Stylized Water for Godot 4 Asset License (LICENSE.txt)
access.price: $0 Lite; full pack $14.99 (on sale $11.24 at check)
access.notes: Use and modify in unlimited commercial or non-commercial games; no attribution required; may not resell/redistribute the shader, scripts or textures alone or in packs, templates or public repos. Code AI-assisted per page.

procedure: Under the file list, click Download next to StylizedWater_Lite_v1.1.1.zip (79 kB, free demo file)
Copy addons/stylized_water_lite into your Godot 4.7+ project
Open examples_lite/lite_demo.tscn or apply water_lite_tropical.tres to a plane

verdict.why: Usable free Godot water shader with a clear commercial license and a well-documented paid upgrade; v1.1 splash update is recent. Lite is deliberately minimal.
